card.fact_statement: Aya Nakamura performed the song "Pookie" at the 2024 Summer Olympics opening ceremony.
card.source_span: French singer Aya Nakamura, who performed a mashup of three songs: "Pookie", "Djadja" and some stanzas from "For me formidable"
